questions.question:
b − 49 = xy
The given equation relates the positive numbers b, x, and y. Which equation correctly expresses x in terms of b and y?

questions.explanation: The graph has a horizontal asymptote at y = 9 and passes through (0, 8), matching y = −6^x + 9. Since y = f(x) + 4, f(x) = −6^x + 5.

The function g is defined by the given equation. For all values of x, the value of g(x) is greater than k, where k is a constant. What is the greatest possible value of k?
questions.explanation: Since 2^x is always positive but can be arbitrarily close to 0, g(x) is always greater than 7/11 and gets arbitrarily close to it, so the greatest k is 7/11.

questions.question:
9x2 + 8 = nx
In the given equation, n is a constant. The equation has exactly one solution. What is the value of (n2)/(8)?
questions.explanation: One solution means the discriminant is 0: n^2 − 4(9)(8) = 0, so n^2 = 288 and n^2/8 = 36.

questions.question:
The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, x and y. A line of best fit is also shown.
Which of the following equations best represents the line of best fit shown?
questions.explanation: The line crosses the y-axis near 3 and rises about 5 for every 3 units right, so y = (5/3)x + 3.

questions.question: The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, x and y. A line of best fit is also shown. Which of the following equations best represents the line of best fit shown?
questions.explanation: The line falls from (−14, 16) to (0, 2), so its slope is −1 and its y-intercept is about 2. Only y = −x + 2.3 fits.

questions.question: The width of a rectangle is 5 centimeters. The length of the rectangle is 30 centimeters longer than the width. What is the area, in square centimeters, of this rectangle?
questions.explanation: The length is 5 + 30 = 35 cm, so the area is 5 × 35 = 175 cm².

questions.question: A certain town has an area of 13,753,344 square yards. What is the area, in <u>square miles</u>, of this town? (1 mile = 1,760 yards)
questions.explanation: 1 square mile = 1,760^2 = 3,097,600 square yards, so the area is 13,753,344 ÷ 3,097,600 ≈ 4.44 square miles.

questions.question: The width of a rectangle is 6 centimeters. The length of the rectangle is 50 centimeters longer than the width. What is the area, in square centimeters, of this rectangle?
questions.explanation: The length is 6 + 50 = 56 cm, so the area is 6 × 56 = 336 square centimeters.

questions.explanation: p depends on (x + 5)^2, so p(−4) = p(−6) = 30 and p(−10) = p(0) = 342. The sum is 372.

questions.question: A district school board in a certain state is proposing a change to the time school starts for all high schools in the district. A sample of 353 high school students was selected at random from all high school students in the district. The selected students were asked whether they approved of the proposed change, and 300 students responded that they did not approve. Which of the following is the largest population to which the results of the survey can be generalized?
options: All high school students in the district
The 300 students who responded that they did not approve of the proposed change
All high school students in the state
questions.explanation: The sample was drawn at random from the district’s high school students, so results generalize to that population only.

questions.question: In a certain state, the population of pheasants, a type of bird, is estimated each year by counting the number of pheasants observed along certain roads in the state. On average, each year from 2005 to 2015 the number of pheasants counted per mile of road decreased by 3.5% of the number of pheasants per mile of road the previous year. Based on this average, if there were 6.32 pheasants per mile of road in this state in 2005, which of the following best approximates the number of pheasants per mile of road in 2015?
questions.explanation: A 3.5% yearly decrease multiplies by 0.965 each year, so after 10 years the amount is 6.32(0.965)^10.

questions.question: Parallelogram ABCD is similar to parallelogram PQRS. The length of each side of parallelogram PQRS is 2 times the length of its corresponding side of parallelogram ABCD. The area of parallelogram ABCD is 30 square centimeters. What is the area, in square centimeters, of parallelogram PQRS?
questions.explanation: Areas scale by the square of the side ratio: 30 × 2^2 = 120.

For a certain rectangle, the ratio of the width to the length is 1 to 2. If the width of the rectangle is 67 centimeters, what is the length, in centimeters, of the rectangle?
questions.explanation: The length is twice the width, so 2 × 67 = 134.

questions.question: A conservation specialist hung artificial nesting structures each in the shape of a right rectangular prism for a species of native duck. Each structure has a height of 12 inches. The length of each structure’s base is x inches, which is 1 inch more than the width of the structure’s base. Which function V gives the volume of each structure, in cubic inches, in terms of the length of the structure’s base?
questions.explanation: The width is x − 1, so V = (length)(width)(height) = x(x − 1)(12) = 12x(x − 1).
